entities.summary: Alexander Hugh Holmes Stuart was a Virginia lawyer and American political figure associated with several political parties. Stuart served in both houses of the Virginia General Assembly, as a U.S. Congressman (1841–1843), and as the Secretary of the Interior (1850–1853). Despite opposing Virginia's secession and holding no office after finishing his term in the Virginia Senate during the American Civil War, after the war he was denied a seat in Congress. Stuart led the Committee of Nine, which attempted to reverse the changes brought by Reconstruction. Alexander Hugh Holmes Stuart was a legal figures from Staunton (1807-04-02, Staunton–1891-02-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
